notes: The CHK-014 tracker isn't visible, so I built a local one. owner=WR is modelled as "write outstanding", which runs from the AW handshake to the B handshake. Parts (a) and (b) share one assertion because they use one fails/hits counter pair. The hit antecedent is o_axi_wready, which also covers every W handshake. A W handshake on the same edge as a new AW handshake counts as beat 1. If an AW handshake happens while a write is still outstanding, it is treated as a new write only when the B handshake occurs on that same edge. I did not compile this or run it in Verilator.
